text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On stage after winning her exhibition race, Silence Suzuka hears cries of "welcome home" from her fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The strong desire to return to them again and again suddenly wells up in her, and she relates that emotion to the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, a few students stop by as we're doing publicity work to express interest. One of them, however, loudly disapproves of our project.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She argues that a concert where everyone gets to sing would be tantamount to a denial of their hard work. Her words leave a heavy silence in their wake.
